_doc: Registered cluster identities (E1.7(b), SS N-119): the non-secret identity stamped into every census head as `db_identity` (database name + domain-tagged sha256 of pg_control_system().system_identifier; no connection details or credentials of any kind). WHAT IT PROVES: the census was read from a cluster with this system identifier, i.e. the same physical cluster LINEAGE: a physical replica or physical restore of production keeps the same identifier, so a census read from a read replica would also match; a logically cloned or re-initialised cluster has a different identity and needs its own entry. It does not prove the live primary. Registration evidence is TWO independent reads of one value by two sessions through their approved read-only reader helpers (both used the role suvarna_reader against the same target: they attest the value, not that the target is production; that is the operators' recorded decision). Append-only by convention.

evidence: read 1: Exec Suvarna Engine, role suvarna_reader (read-only), census helper asset_census._db_identity() (PR #3088), 2026-10-03: database=amjis, hash=dc44e645...1731
